allowance_grant_day_shape.name: allowance_grant_day_shape
allowance_grant_day_shape.value: (type = 'welcome' and day = 'first') or (type = 'daily' and day glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]')

coupon_code_shape.name: coupon_code_shape
coupon_code_shape.value: code = upper(code) and instr(code, ' ') = 0 and instr(code, '-') = 0

daily_checkin_shape.name: daily_checkin_shape
daily_checkin_shape.value: kind in ('claim', 'shield') and day glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' and streak_day >= 1 and amount >= 0 and (kind = 'claim' or amount = 0)

jackpot_pool_shape.name: jackpot_pool_shape
jackpot_pool_shape.value: seed >= 0 and cap > seed and pool >= 0 and pool <= cap and round >= 1
